metadata.description: Documentation explaining how authentication works with Supabase in PostSpark 3, including frontend and backend components
metadata.context: Explains the two-layer authentication system using Supabase Auth

metadata.description: Frontend auth components: supabaseClient.ts, authBridge.ts, useAuth.ts, LoginModal.tsx
metadata.context: Frontend files that handle authentication in the browser

metadata.description: Backend auth components: supabaseAuth.ts, sdk.ts, context.ts, cookies.ts, index.ts
metadata.context: Backend files that handle authentication on the server

metadata.description: HTTP-only cookie cannot be read directly by JavaScript, protecting against certain attacks. Backend receives cookie in requests but scripts can't copy its content

Auth flow: User login → Frontend receives session → Frontend calls /api/auth/supabase-session → Backend validates → Backend creates httpOnly cookie → tRPC calls include cookie → Backend builds ctx.user → Protected procedures use ctx.user
